0022600101.text: The Warriors have not played a 2026-27 game yet, while the Grizzlies are 1-0, sitting 2nd in the Southwest and 3rd in the West. Golden State is missing Brandin Podziemski (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (ankle). Golden State won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 133-112 win in Memphis on February 25, 2026, and the two teams have not yet met this season.
